description: Saneamento - 1º Balanço do PAC 2015 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Empreendimentos pertencentes à Carteira do PAC. Dados do 1º balanço do PAC de 2015 referentes ao período de Janeiro a Junho de 2015 e fornecem informações sobre os empreendimentos presentes na carteira de projetos do programa. Os dados estão em escala de planejamento e podem ocorrer imprecisões em escala municipal. Fonte:. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Empreendimento, PAC, Saneamento. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
